items.title: AMETEK, Eaton and Dover Are Delivering Record Results. Can Their Dividends Keep Growing?

items.title: 4 Industrial Dividend Kings Whose Streaks Survived Every Recession
items.summary: Industrial manufacturers face collapsing orders every time the economy stumbles, yet four companies have kept raising their dividends through every recession on record, and the secrets behind those streaks reveal something counterintuitive about how they are built to survive.
